_metadata.description: MAN TGS 36.430 8x4-4 BL CH tridem chassis (UK, 2022, TN cab, wheelbase 3600): leaf-sprung steer axle, air-sprung tandem drive and a steered, liftable trailing (tag) axle. Axle positions, weights, tyres, rims, suspension types, turning circle and driveline are published; geometry details and rates are estimates.
_metadata.author: RFloEng

data_origin.detail: Published by MAN (body-builder chassis sheet): axle spacings L1/L2/L3, overhangs, width across rear tyres, frame height, unladen and plated loads, tyres, rims, suspension types, lift/steer tag axle, engine, gearbox ratios, axle ratio, turning circle. Estimated (_est): hardpoints, tracks, CG, spring/damper/stabiliser rates, axle masses, tag-axle steering ratio and lift travel.
